{{Quote|Just after the Yuuzhan Vong War, one of the original Pop-Dogs, Captain Jam Javat, bought this property and turned it into a preserve. He retired a major a few years back and moved out of the Coruscant system|Myri Antilles|<ref name="X-Wing: Mercy Kill" />}}
'''Jam Javat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who carried the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and was an original member of the [[Pop-Dogs]]. After the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Javat purchased property on [[Vandor-3]] and converted it into the [[Javat Caridan Environment]], a preserve for wildlife from [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] following the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Destruction of Carida|destruction]]. A few [[Standard year|years]] prior to [[44 ABY]], Javat retired as a [[Major/Legends|major]] and moved out of the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]], leaving the preserve under the operation of a trust.<ref name="X-Wing: Mercy Kill" />
